# MRMhub Workflow Examples

::: {.lead}
Reproducible, worked examples of the MRMhub targeted LC-MS data-processing pipeline
:::

::: {.title-sep}
:::

These notebooks reproduce the [**MRMhub**](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub) pipeline end-to-end on real targeted LC-MS datasets — from INTEGRATOR peak-integration results through QUANT normalization, quantification, quality control and reporting. Each is a self-contained Quarto notebook combining narrative, executable R and outputs, provided as Supplementary Materials for the MRMhub manuscript.

## Workflows

::: {.arrow-list}
- **[Dataset 1 ↗](Dataset1.html)** — targeted plasma lipidomics, Tan *et al.* [@tan2022]; 503 features across 937 samples. ISTD normalization, quantification, drift/batch correction and QC filtering.
- **[Dataset 3 ↗](Dataset3.html)** — targeted lipidomics, Chen *et al.* [@chen2025]; 829 features across 4,591 samples. The same pipeline at population scale.
- **[Dataset 4 ↗](Dataset4.html)** — fully quantitative steroid assay (Panel 1, 15 analytes) with external calibration, low/high QC and EQA samples [@jansen2014]. Validates MRMhub against Agilent MassHunter across the INTEGRATOR (peak areas) and QUANT (concentrations) modules.
:::
